difficulty_reason: In the chapter's descend-resolution-property situation (a proper representable morphism pi : Y -> X of finite type between Noetherian algebraic spaces with an ample ideal sheaf I on Y), assuming X Noetherian, X has the resolution property if and only if pi_* I is a quotient of a finite locally free O_X-module. The retained proof is written: pi_* I is coherent (Cohomology of Spaces, lemma finite-pushforward-coherent), so the forward direction is the definition of the resolution property; conversely, from a surjection E -> pi_* I with E finite locally free, the multiplication maps pi_* I tensor pi_* I^n -> pi_* I^{n+1} are surjective (the displayed sequence), an induction giving E^{tensor n} ->> pi_* I^n for all n, and the chapter's preceding surjection-in-Noetherian-case lemma converts the tower of surjections into the resolution property for X. Retained author proof at lines 13545-13563.
